name: the_filing_response_already_carries_every_derived_total
setup: canonical district ACTIVE with FY2027-Q1 open and four statements generated NOT_FILED
assert: the filing response itself already carries filing_status == FILED, filed_at == 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z, provisional_assessment_cents == 824500, effective_assessment_cents == 824500, total_due_cents == 824500 and version == 2
the immediately following GET of the same statement returns exactly those seven values, with no field still null or stale
GET /assessment-periods/${ap_id} returns billed_total_cents == 824500 and collected_total_cents == 0 on the first read after the filing
GET /districts/${d_id}/financial-summary returns billed_total_cents == 824500, collected_to_date_cents == 0, statement_count == 4 and delinquent_statement_count == 0
no repeated read changes any of these figures, since the whole recompute is inside the filing request

name: a_remittance_reaches_the_district_ledger_inside_the_same_request
setup: canonical district ACTIVE, FY2027-Q1 open, st1 filed at 824500 with nothing paid
assert: the remittance response carries applied_to_interest_cents == 0, applied_to_penalty_cents == 0, applied_to_principal_cents == 824500, applied_to_credit_cents == 0, status == APPLIED and version == 1
by the time that 201 returns AssessmentStatement.${st1_id}.principal_paid_cents == 824500, credit_balance_cents == 0, total_due_cents == 0, payment_status == PAID_IN_FULL and version == 3
the following GET of the statement returns the same five values unchanged
District.${d_id}.collected_to_date_cents == 824500 and AssessmentPeriod.${ap_id}.collected_total_cents == 824500 on the first read after the payment
GET /districts/${d_id}/financial-summary returns collected_to_date_cents == 824500, billed_total_cents == 824500, credit_total_cents == 0 and delinquent_charges_cents == 0
